observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox One S console with a white controller in front of it, placed on a wooden surface. The console has a textured front panel and a visible disc slot.

Photo 1 shows the same white Xbox One S console with two controllers: one white and one black, placed on a pink fabric surface. The console has a perforated front panel. A black cable is visible next to the controllers.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage in either photo.
The controllers are standard Xbox-style, with the white one matching the console and the black one being a different color.
No games or accessories (like power brick, HDMI cable, etc.) are visible in either photo.
The seller claims 'games on it' and 'all the accessories', but no games or additional accessories are shown.

identity.kind: Xbox One S console with two controllers

claims.claim: Xbox one s console with one controller and games on it
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the console and two controllers, but no games are visible. The claim of 'games on it' cannot be verified from the photos.
No power brick, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in either photo. The claim cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/axes
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Games may not be included or may be damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the games discs or digital game codes, or a video showing the games being loaded and played.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power brick, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: Photos of all accessories laid out next to the console and controllers.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working.
Photos of the games discs or digital codes.
Photos of all accessories (power brick, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
